primitives.name: Agent-to-Agent Send
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **Agent-to-agent sends are still sends.** A handoff to another bot counts as an external action in the strictest templates.
primitives.assumptions: All inter-agent communication is treated as an external action with explicit state transition.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When A1 sends S to A2, E(A1→A2) = 1; otherwise E = 0.

layer2.mapping: Each send maps to a deterministic state update in a shared Markov chain with bounded entropy.
layer2.telemetry: Count of external actions per session

primitives.name: Evidence Bar
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **Evidence bars are numeric.** Where a bot recommends, it must cite live data, a mechanism, and a reason-now; anything less is labeled a lead.
primitives.assumptions: Recommendations require all three components to qualify as valid evidence.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If D ∧ M ∧ N then R else L = 1.

layer2.mapping: Evidence bar defines a kernel function over recommendation quality based on verifiable inputs.
layer2.telemetry: Proportion of valid recommendations vs leads

primitives.name: First Run Interview
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **First-run interviews are standard.** The bot asks setup questions on first contact and saves answers to memory — the template's way of surviving the loss of the creator's private context.
primitives.assumptions: Initial interaction preserves operational context via structured input storage.
primitives.breakdown_regime: F = 1 ⇒ Q → M; C = 1 if M persists post-session.

layer2.mapping: Interview process mirrors a context-preserving encoder-decoder system with memory retention.
layer2.telemetry: Percentage of sessions with preserved context
